instructions.question: What sentiment does the author of this German tweet express: positive, neutral or negative?
instructions.rule: Judge the author's attitude, not the topic. Ads, plain news, results, fan requests, likes, calm opinions and greetings that only open a question or information are neutral. Stand-alone greetings, regards, welcomes, invitations with :) and proud success announcements are positive. The author's own tiredness, boredom, confusion (o_O, :/), curt dismissals and headlines with alarm words are negative; laughing emoticons make teasing of others positive but do not cancel a complaint about one's own mood.

neutral.what: Plain news, sports results, ads, classifieds, check-ins, questions, likes, fan requests and calm opinions without clear feeling.
examples: Guten Morgen! Wir wollen euch noch erzählen, was #Apple gestern in Sachen #iPhone erzählt hat: http (Good morning! We want to tell you what Apple said yesterday about the iPhone)
Nike Air Delta Force High White *kaum getragen*: Erlangen | Verkaufe coole Nike Air Delta Force High in weiß, ... http (barely worn: selling cool Nike shoes in white)
Venedig: Großer Preis der Jury für Film aus Taiwan! http (Venice: Grand Jury Prize for a film from Taiwan!)
neutral.cues: headline plus link, RT of news, prices, Verkaufe (selling), +1, positiv bewertet (rated positively), bitte spielt (please play)
neutral.not_for: Headlines with alarm words or emotional comment, e.g. 'Unfassbar!' (unbelievable!), are negative. Personal tiredness is negative.

positive.what: Joy, praise, thanks, greetings or regards on their own, welcomes, invitations, affection, excitement, pride in success, playful teasing with laughing emoticons.
examples: SIEG!!!!!!!! Chemie gewinnt 2-0 gegen Osnabrück :-D #liga3 (VICTORY!!! Chemie wins 2-0 against Osnabrück)
@user good morning
Instandhaltung erfolgreich abgeschlossen! (maintenance successfully completed!)
Schäm dich einfach :P (just be ashamed of yourself :P)
positive.cues: :) / :D / :P / ♥, Gruß (regards), herzlich willkommen (warm welcome), Glückwunsch (congratulations), danke (thanks), genial (brilliant), erfolgreich (successful)
positive.not_for: A greeting opening a question, e.g. 'Gute Nacht! Können Sie erklären…' (good night! can you explain…), is neutral. Ads are neutral even with praise.

negative.what: Complaints, anger, disgust, sadness, insults, bitter sarcasm, curt dismissals, the author's own tiredness, boredom or confusion, and alarming bad news.
examples: Och ne, jetzt singt Nicole auch noch? HILFE. #sg (Oh no, now Nicole is singing too? HELP.)
Ich werde gerade dezent nicht wach... (I'm kind of not waking up right now...)
Derp meine Laune will nicht so recht steigen ^^ (derp, my mood just won't lift ^^)
negative.cues: :( / :/ / o_O, scheiße (shit), nervig (annoying), langeweile (boredom), Mist (damn), hasse (hate), Schade (pity), pssst, alarmierend (alarming), furchterregend (frightening)
negative.not_for: Neutral reports or third-party criticism, e.g. 'Forrester-Analyst übt scharfe Kritik' (analyst sharply criticizes), stay neutral. Teasing others with :P is positive.
